# Anne Shirley & Josephine Barry

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) — firm friends who talk and amuse each other · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P94](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0094), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attend the [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert and spend the night with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). After enjoying the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed and accidentally jump on Diana's elderly [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). The next day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) is furious and threatening to leave.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P48](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0048), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P52](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0052), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P58](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0058)_

> After speaking with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to apologize directly to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for jumping onto her bed. Anne's honest confession and imaginative defense amuse Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), convincing her to forgive [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) become good friends throughout the rest of her visit.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P66](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0066), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P79](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0079), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P87](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0087), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P90](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0090)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) turns thirteen and talks with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) on their walk to school about growing up, writing compositions, and her melodramatic story. Inspired, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) forms a story club with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), Ruby, and Jane, which [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scoffs at when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) describes their efforts.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P22](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0022)_

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) invites [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to visit her [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) allows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to go, and Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) drives the girls into town where they stay at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood). After enjoying days at the fair, a concert, and exploring the city, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) are driven home, concluding that while city life was exciting, they are glad to be back.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P11](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P33](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0033)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) bid farewell to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), who realizes how much she enjoyed Anne's company. After a pleasant drive back, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) welcome her home with a hot supper as she recounts her trip.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) settles into student life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), forming close friendships and maintaining her healthy academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She spends time visiting [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) and eventually prepares alongside her [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) classmates as spring brings upcoming final examinations.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns that she has won the Avery scholarship while [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal at Queen's. After Commencement, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), catches up with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and notices concerning signs about Matthew's and Marilla's health, as well as worries about their bank.
>
